summary: A +2 hand crossbow that can Burn targets hit from Hiding or Invisibility.

fields.Hellstalker: A hit while you are Hiding or Invisible forces a DC 15 Constitution save or Burning for 2 turns. The linked rule reports the save is hidden in the combat log.
fields.Scorching Ray Shot: Action once per Short Rest. Cast level 3 Scorching Ray, firing four separate ranged spell attacks out to 60 ft. Each ray deals 2d6 Fire.
fields.Base value: 770 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Acquisition note: Obtaining it grants Tools of the Trade inspiration to Outlanders.
